notes.title: Playtest Version Now Available In Gcores Game Page
notes.notes:
G-Fusion Game Festival 2025 Beijing is live this weekend!


STARVEIL PROTOCOL A.A.A. is showcasing its latest version at the event—come try it out at booth B02 (Whisper Games) or B09 (GCORES Publishing) and chat directly with the developer! We value your feedback deeply.



For those unable to attend in person, we've also prepared a special online Playtest version with a rich content offering. While the Steam Playtest is still pending approval, we didn’t want to keep you waiting—head over to the GCORES game page to download the same version being showcased at the event!



We'll release the official Playtest version on Steam as soon as it’s approved, and notify everyone right away.


Thank you again for your passionate support!



-Lots of Love from Aine & Akimi
